beats.text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Bao heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
🪤 Bao is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
Recipe: Snare (Level 1). You have seen a snare. A loop, a stick, an animal.

🪤 Bao catches you watching the snares come off the line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They show you — the loop, the trigger stick, where the run narrows between the roots. "Opossum trails. Check at dawn. Always." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
